intent: 동일한 이동 집계 조건에서 Digest의 섹터별 연접과 주민별 한 번 적재를 비교한다
invariants: Movement aggregation applies before and after
No move Msg is made until tick end
Chat source sector is captured at receipt
Source-sector buffers survive all receiving-sector copies
One Digest construction per receiving sector with residents
Every resident receives a byte copy of the same completed Digest
Original Msg headers are retained; Digest adds no wire header
SendQ is a byte ring, depicted with numbered logical Msg marks
Fixed Digest box; same actor, ring geometry and blue PCB palette
omitted: Actor self-reception and other residents outside the viewport
ordering: Selected source sectors are concatenated in grid order and Msgs in per-sector insertion order. The chosen example matches the baseline byte order; no global time ordering claim.
validationScope: Source review and animation-model/runtime harness; not a running server-binary comparison
